title: Why Hiring Needs 8 Steps: Staffing | Principles of Management Ep 17
description:
Meena runs the busy bus stand Chai Corner, and she needs two more helpers. Last year Ravi hired the first person who asked, and that helper quit in a week. This time he uses staffing to find, place and keep the right people.

You will see what staffing means (filling every job with the right person, and keeping it filled) and the 8 steps of staffing: manpower planning, recruitment, selection, placement and orientation, training, appraisal, promotion and transfer, and compensation. We run a live hiring funnel at Chai Corner, 40 applicants to 10 interviews to 2 hires, and see why recruitment is called positive and selection negative. We compare internal and external sources of recruitment, and look at staffing at work today: a hospital planning night shifts, campus hiring, a bank's written test, a call centre agent's first week, and a yearly goal review. Then the human side: careful staffing gives the right fit and fewer people quitting, but it costs time and money, and interviewers can be biased. A 2022 review of hiring research found structured interviews, the same questions for everyone, predicted job performance best.

This is Episode 17 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
